description: This file is a shell script for launching an external diff or merge tool compatible with Git's diff and mergetool interfaces. It manages prompts, external commands, and the execution flow for merging or diffing files within a Git environment.

methods.name: should_prompt
methods.description: Determines whether the diff/merge should prompt the user before launching the external tool based on git configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: use_ext_cmd
methods.description: Checks if an external command for diff/merge is specified through environment variable GIT_DIFFTOOL_EXTCMD.

methods.name: launch_merge_tool
methods.description: Handles prompting the user and launching the external diff or merge tool, passing the relevant filenames and environment variables.
